description:
A landrace-specific NLR cluster in the Watkins pangenome: nine NLR loci that co-occur in 58
Watkins landraces (mainly AG4, AG3, AG6; Afghanistan, former USSR, Greece, Iran, Spain) and are absent from all 217
modern cultivars, including a complete CC-NBARC-LRR gene (best UniProt match rice blast resistance protein Pikm2),
placed by read-pair links near TraesCS2A02G590100 on distal 2AL. Returns the 58 carriers and the NLR genes.
name: watkins_nlr_cluster
